interrupted_launches.reason: Three initial concurrent CLI requests were rate-limited (429). The circuit breaker stopped collection. No known business outcomes were obtained.
Four-worker paced Luna launch also encountered 429 errors before any completed business outcome. Retain every request and keep all interrupted rewards unknown.

known_contrast_diagnostic.analysis_status: Post hoc diagnostic added after inspecting token-boundary groups; not the primary metric.
known_contrast_diagnostic.definition: Counts incomplete groups whose known eligible rewards already include both 0 and 1. Unknown rewards are never imputed. No training benefit is inferred.

capacity_interruption.selection_rule: Retain every entire arm that reached its frozen token boundary. Repeat every other arm in full, without using its rewards to select the restart. Preserve all excluded attempts and their known rewards as infrastructure overhead; do not pool their outcomes into the matched comparison.

session_interruption.reason: The local tool-session refresh interrupted the remaining collector. Its process, watcher, pipeline and last CLI child were no longer present; the last raw request remained pending.
session_interruption.selection_rule: Retain every whole token-finished arm. Repeat the only incomplete arm, selected solely by completion status, from a fresh environment and full allowance. Do not resubmit or modify the abandoned pending request.
